scripts.format: swift format format --in-place --recursive --parallel --configuration .swift-format Package.swift Sources Tests
scripts.format:check: swift format lint --recursive --parallel --strict --configuration .swift-format Package.swift Sources Tests
scripts.xcode:verify: bun run xcode:generate && xcodebuild -project QuotaBar.xcodeproj -scheme QuotaBar -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -derivedDataPath .build/xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build
scripts.archive:macos: bun run xcode:generate && xcodebuild -project QuotaBar.xcodeproj -scheme QuotaBar -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' -archivePath dist/QuotaBar.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
scripts.verify:macos: bun run format:check && bun run lint:swift && bun run coverage:macos && bun run xcode:verify && bun run bundle:macos && bun run verify:bundle
